task_instance: Write a @QuarkusTest for a JAX-RS GreetingResource (GET /hello returning "Hello") using RestAssured, and verify it passes by running the test suite with Dev Services, as the skill's core deliverable describes.
blocker_detail: The core deliverable is a working, verified Quarkus test. Authoring the Java sources as text is possible, but verifying them requires executing the Maven wrapper test lifecycle (compile Java, launch the JVM, boot the Quarkus @QuarkusTest harness) and, for the skill's Dev Services feature, automatically starting a container runtime for a database/broker. This office-assistant runtime grants only reading, writing and editing text files plus web access; it cannot run code, compile, launch a JVM, invoke a build tool, or start containers, so the test can never be executed or its pass/fail result observed. No credential, network, or safety issue is involved; the blocker is purely the absence of code/build/container execution.
evidence: Wrote sample Quarkus project input files under the work directory: src/main/java/org/acme/GreetingResource.java (JAX-RS resource) and src/test/java/org/acme/GreetingResourceTest.java (@QuarkusTest + RestAssured, mirroring the SKILL.md example). Verification of the deliverable per the skill's 'Running' section needs the Maven wrapper test phase (JVM + build tool) and a container runtime for Dev Services; none of these can be invoked because no code/command execution is available in this runtime, so the tests could not be compiled or run and no pass result could be confirmed.
